title: Reject unsupported manual stock-in units before procurement receipt persistence
description: Close a real unit-integrity gap in manual procurement receipts. Shared StockUnitConversion.NormalizeAsync loads product, converts only if line.Unit equals PackageUnit and differs from baseUnit, otherwise continues unchanged. A nonempty arbitrary unit such as KG for a PCS/CTN product therefore persists while inventory quantity is ultimately treated in base units. Linked purchase rules cover some source-unit checks; unlinked manual rows do not. Add shared pure/batched unit eligibility guard and enable it for StockIn paths first; retain other families until their dependent tasks deliberately enable equivalent validation. Use existing service/controller paths and live product snapshots; never infer a procurement source or invent an exchange factor. Preserve current identity/menu/customer scope, live product/warehouse/supplier validation, source ownership/capacity locks and atomic posting/reversal. No new grants, schema/migration, database, automatic source links or historical unit rewrite. Only explicitly supplied nonempty unsupported units are rejected; preserve established empty-unit/base-unit fallback after checking existing code/tests, or fail controlled if no base unit exists rather than inventing a new unit. Case-insensitive trimmed comparisons use current semantics. Package conversion applies exactly once using current positive UnitsPerPackage, keeps authoritative base quantity and existing rounding policy; downstream storage bounds and overflow guards remain. No conversion/inference between arbitrary units. No new historical read/cancel/unaudit gate. Adapt original unit/SQL fixtures genuinely without deleting assertions. Unique unused per-invocation logs/TRX under .ai/logs/<task>; preserve full original failures. Genuine SQL uses fresh GUID NEWERP_AUTOTEST only, no drop/reset/reuse/production. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized manual and linked draft writes reject explicitly supplied units outside the referenced live product base/package units before number reservation, tracked header/detail replacement or any persistence. Preserve existing supported blank-unit fallback and valid base/package inputs, repeated product rows and optional source semantics; invalid/missing base/package configuration yields controlled error without guessing.

Operational submit/approve revalidate effective stored unit/master/source eligibility in existing document/source locks. Package quantity is normalized exactly once and not reconverted on commitment; existing base-unit source capacity, monetary quantities, current precision/overflow guards and inventory ledger remain coherent. Rejection changes no document/status/source capacity/numbers/stock/movements; historical undo/read semantics remain.

Meaningful unit/controller and genuine isolated SQL cover unlinked and linked drafts, arbitrary nonempty unit, whitespace/case/base/package inputs, blank fallback, invalid/mutated base or package master, conversion factors/overflow, cumulative source capacity after conversion and no double conversion. Run related original fulfillment/posting/source/cancellation/concurrency SQL regressions plus safe Release/full units, preserving original failures and exact environment evidence.
implementation_evidence: StockUnitConversion.cs:46 skips missing product and:50-51 continues for any unit not equal PackageUnit. StockIn draft guards504 validate product/numeric shape, not unit membership. Optional purchase source validation skips unlinked receipts; existing342/375 protect explicit procurement capacity but do not cover arbitrary manual units. Full tasks/docs review found no stock-in unsupported-unit guard task.
